Name: Emily Dialogue Reworked
Author: Jinglefox
Description:
Emily no longer is the type of woman to believe in homeopathy. Tones down references to mysticism and magic, turns up references to textiles and working on clothes. Also adds a bit more of a darker element regarding Clint's stalkerish behavior.

-Rewrites most of the lines in the base game
-Adds at least one line for every day for every 2 heart levels you go up
-Might have some hiccups, please post a screenshot or describe the bug including the day, season, and heart level with Emily.

To install:

Navigate to your Stardew Valley folder (probably in program files) and place emily.xnb in Content\Characters\Dialogue.

Downloads.Description: Includes vanilla rainy.xnb and modded Emily.xnb. Contains rainy because I released a bad version of it earlier. Oops.
